messages:
alex: Quick question — prepping a service account for the CI pipeline. We need it to fetch logs from the project and trigger debug jobs in a specific infra namespace. Is granting `roles/viewer` + `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` enough, or should we lock this down further? cc @maria @samir

maria: Project Viewer is pretty broad. For reading logs you only need `roles/logging.viewer` (or an equivalent custom role). `serviceAccountUser` (or `iam.serviceAccounts.actAs`) is needed if the pipeline impersonates an SA to run jobs. Avoid `Editor` or `Owner`.

alex: OK — so `roles/logging.viewer` + `iam.serviceAccountUser` scoped to the target SA. How do we scope logging access to just the CI logs, not everything?

jess: You can bind `roles/logging.viewer` at the project level but better: bind to the log resource or create a custom role with just the logging read perms you need. Example command we use: 
```
# give logging viewer to the CI SA for project-ci
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding PROJECT-CI \
  --member=serviceAccount:ci-runner@PROJECT-CI.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/logging.viewer
```
That covers reading logs. For cross-project, consider using a logs export sink + a service account limited to the sink.

samir: For security I'd recommend a custom role instead of project-level builtin. Minimal perms we use: `logging.logEntries.list`, `logging.logEntries.get`, and `logging.logs.list` (drop write perms). If the pipeline needs to read log-based metrics include `logging.metrics.list`. Also add a condition to limit by resource if possible.

alex: Good call. Any approval process required? This SA will only fetch last 24h test-run logs (no PII expected).

maria: Create a short PR in infra-iam with the requested bindings, rationale, and an expiry date. Tag it with `security:review` and include the pipeline owner. We can pre-approve short-lived grants (30 days) but prefer rotating creds. :thumbsup:

security-bot: NOTICE: Created ticket INFRA-3142 for IAM change request (auto-generated).

alex: PR opened: https://git.internal/infra/iam/changes/42 — added description + link to failing job logs. PTAL @samir @jess

samir: LGTM. Two tiny nits: mention log retention for that project and scope the role to `projects/PROJECT-CI` resource only. After merge, ask oncall to run the smoke pipeline to validate.

alex: Will update PR and set 30-day expiry on the binding. Thanks all :party_parrot:
